question: Q13: should agents keep the git route on Overleaf, or post edits as tracked-change suggestions from a bot account (claudeleaf)?

solvers.answer: Keep the git route; no claudeleaf, no hybrid.
Keep git for every agent write; no suggestion mode, no bot account now.

refutation.note: Suggestion mode makes every agent edit an accept/reject item (the per-edit review A1 rejected); the pull would read pending bot suggestions as accepted text (Q12); A3 names the git route.

final_answer: Keep git for all agent writes; no claudeleaf, no bot account.
answer_short: Agents keep writing through git; no claudeleaf, no bot account.
